name: Suzuki RGV250 Gamma
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke V-twin, two carbs, oil injection, power valves
intro: Suzuki's two-stroke V-twin sport bike, mostly sold outside the US. Power valves, oil injection and race-bred parts.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.

recallNote: Most of these were sold new outside the US, so the NHTSA search may not cover them. Ask a Suzuki dealer to check the frame number.
